result: Second correction from the owner adopted, this time by opening the sources the development entry pointed at (FOUNDING-POSITIONS, COVENANT-MARK-AND-SITUATION, EXPRESSION-WORLD-SUBSTRATE-WAYFINDER, a Bimba coordinate journey).
